correctness.rationale: The E_i are nested and E_H is universal; recursively defined set-valued signatures characterize modal equivalence because characteristic formulas at level i are made from Diamond_i and Box_i of child-signature formulas. Equality of the entire leaf-to-level-(H-1) vector defines a color-respecting bisimulation, so precisely K vectors give 2^K Boolean algebra elements. Full generation requires a rigid colored rooted partition tree and rigidity suffices by uniqueness of child types at each parent. In a regular rooted hierarchy the tree distinguishing recursion A_0=q, A_i=binom(A_(i-1),b_i) and labeled child assignments give the displayed generating-tuple count. A_i(2) yields no rigid binary hierarchy for H>=2, while A_i(4)>0; the 3-type construction yields distinct height-(H-1) subtrees with matching shallower leaf types, giving sharp modal depth H-1. Independently enumerated all colorings of the four-world height-2 regular binary frame for q=2,3,4, confirming rigid full-generation colorings 0,24,120 (the q=2 count is zero). Boundary H=1 gives depth zero, consistent.
